workarounds.note: 1.4.1 reports parse issues and calloutOverflow only; proof() finds the rest itself: every :ref and ::resource id diffed against the resources, every ::: name against KNOWN_CONTAINERS and KNOWN_DIRECTIVES, lists numbered from a year and formulas read from parseMarkdownWithIssues' blocks, loose lines and hyphens inside addresses read from the layout's lines (gotchas sandbox-only-warnings, unknown-ref-silent)

paintMarks() washes loose lines itself from line.justifiedSpaceRatio after renderPageToCanvas: 1.4.1 paints the loose-line highlight only in the Sandbox and exports no helper to draw it on a canvas of your own
col() writes the hex beside every paletteId: 1.4.1 skips the palette in design slots (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break)
the kicker, headline, standfirst and byline under the night-crossing drawing reserve the opener's height; the image element alone would reserve nothing (gotcha opener-image-no-reserve)
the headline and standfirst set lineHeight as multiples (0.96, 1.3), never as dimensions (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)
bodyText.maxRuntTracking: 0, so no runt fix tightens tracking that 1.4.1 never paints (gotcha runt-tracking-unpainted)

the lede is copy-fitted so the fact box's first fragment fills page 1 to its last line: with a line to spare, 1.4.1's column balancing pushes a box that closes a column down to the column's foot, leaving a gap between the fares paragraph and the box's stripe
linesOf() runs each justified line's wash and click target to the right edge of its block: 1.4.1 keeps the line's natural width in line.bbox, not the width it is painted at
